schemes.OAuth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["delete:project:jira"]: "Delete projects and their details, such as issue types, project lead, and avatars."

schemes.OAuth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["manage:jira-configuration"]: "Configure Jira settings that require the Jira administrators permission, for example, create projects and custom fields, view workflows, manage issue link types."
schemes.OAuth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["manage:jira-project"]: "Create and edit project settings and create new project-level objects, for example, versions, components."

schemes.OAuth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["manage:jira-webhook"]: "Manage Jira webhooks. Enables an OAuth app to register and unregister dynamic webhooks in Jira. It also provides for fetching of registered webhooks."
schemes.OAuth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["read:email-address:jira"]: "View email addresses of all users regardless of the user's profile visibility settings."
schemes.OAuth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["read:jira-user"]: "View user information in Jira that you have access to, including usernames, email addresses, and avatars."
schemes.OAuth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["read:jira-work"]: "Read project and issue data. Search for issues and objects associated with issues (such as attachments and worklogs)."
schemes.OAuth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["write:avatar:jira"]: "Create and update system and custom avatars."
schemes.OAuth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["write:bulk-job:jira"]: "Create and manage bulk jobs, including uploads, retries, and cancellation."
schemes.OAuth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["write:filter.default-share-scope:jira"]: "Create and update filter default share scopes."
schemes.OAuth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["write:issue-type-screen-scheme:jira"]: "Create and update issue type screen schemes."
schemes.OAuth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["write:jira-work"]: "Create and edit issues in Jira, post comments, create worklogs, and delete issues."
schemes.basicAuth.description: "You can access this resource via basic auth."
